datasets.title: Mayotte - GRID3 MYT - Settlement Extents v3.0
datasets.description: The GRID3 MYT - Settlement Extents v3.0 consists of a geographic representation of settlements in Mayotte, in two forms: (1) settlement polygons, and (2) spatial points depicting the centroids of settled grid cells at 3-arc seconds (or ~100 meters) contained within settlement polygons. Both layers include attributes as described in the codebooks. Recommended Citation: Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN), Columbia University. 2024. entity.name: Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN), Columbia University

lineage.description: Settlement extents were mapped using satellite imagery and geospatial analysis to identify populated areas in Mayotte. The dataset was processed into two complementary representations: settlement boundary polygons and gridded population centroids at 3-arc second (~100 meter) resolution, providing a foundational exposure layer for disaster risk assessment.
